items.title: Dan Barrett interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: little by little we got to know the guys in the band... I remember the trombonist... his name is Frank Demond... he would show me musical things

ctx.x: Well I think it’s marvelous how somebody answers your questions and shows you the possibilities. You know, talk to us about how jazz improvisation shows us the innerds of the music.

All right. Well about that same time that I discovered Tommy Dorsey, there was a jazz band playing at a pizza parlor in Huntington Beach. And my brother-in-law, who is a very good trumpet player here on the west coast, he and I often remarked how our musical lives would be different had we not gotten to hear that band. It’s called the South Frisco Jazz Band. In fact, they’re here at the festival this week. Their personnel has changed a little bit over the years, but they were playing Friday and Saturday nights at…

Orleans jazz every Friday and Saturday night we’d go over there. And you’re talking about improvisation, we didn’t understand how they were playing all this music without having any notes in front of them you know? And little by little we got to know the guys in the band and I think they were amused that a bunch of high school kids would think so much of them to show up every weekend. And during their breaks they’d sit and talk with us. And I remember the trombonist, who now plays with one of the Preservation…
